purpose: Server-authoritative product ownership, receipts, purchases, and gifting.
description: Coordinates Roblox product ownership, purchase receipts, gifting, and server-authoritative product handlers across the network boundary.

GameProductService.luau.description: GameConfig-backed purchase prompting, ownership queries, and receipt-safe developer-product fulfillment. Developer products are granted only from ProcessReceipt through ReceiptProcessingService. PromptProductPurchaseFinished is used only to detect a cancelled prompt.

GameProductServiceClient.luau.description: Client purchase prompting and receipt-confirmed purchase observation. Public entry points include `GameProductServiceClient.Init`, `GameProductServiceClient.Start`, `GameProductServiceClient.PromptPurchaseAsync`, `GameProductServiceClient.HasAssetAsync`, `GameProductServiceClient.RegisterOwnershipProvider`, `GameProductServiceClient.GetPurchaseCountThisSession`, `GameProductServiceClient.ObservePurchase`,…

Shared/GameProductDataService.luau.description: Compatibility purchase-data facade used by access and entitlement packages. The original Nevermore service reads `PlayerProductManager` binders. This fork already owns prompting, receipts, ownership providers, and session purchase state in [GameProductService], so this service keeps the upstream API while delegating to the existing product services.

Shared/GameProductHandlerResult.luau.description: Results returned by GameProductService purchase handlers.

Shared/GameProductNetwork.luau.description: Compact server-to-client purchase results for GameProductService.

Shared/GameProductUtils.luau.description: Shared helpers for the two GameProductService asset categories. Public entry points include `GameProductUtils.isProductAssetType`, `GameProductUtils.assetTypeToCode`, `GameProductUtils.codeToAssetType`.
